card.name: Partway through toxicity-study words
card.fires_on: Responds partway through long toxicology words such as tumorigenicity, malformations, carcinogenicity and embryo-fetal, just before the word is completed. Also fires on a few words that precede a fixed continuation, such as 'et al' and 'not less'.

modes.label: Inside toxicity terms
modes.description: A middle piece of a long word about tumors, birth defects or cancer risk in animal studies.

modes.label: Embryo-fetal warning heading
modes.description: The 'AL' ending of FETAL in boxed warning headings.

modes.label: Linking words in set phrases
modes.description: A short word that is expected to be followed by a fixed continuation.
modes.example: over a period of not<< less>> than 3 minutes.

card.plain: It lights up in the middle of long toxicity words like tumorigenicity or embryo-fetal, before the word finishes.
